cohort: The study included 96 pregnant women with premature rupture of membranes (PROM) treated at Anhui Province Mengcheng County, People's Hospital.
finding: Intensive psychological nursing improved the emotions, increased natural delivery rates, shortened labor, reduced pain, lessened neonatal asphyxia, and improved nursing satisfaction in pregnant women with PROM.
mod_finding: Intensive psychological nursing significantly increased the rate of natural delivery compared to routine nursing.
